note: Meridian Atlas 3.12 event additions filling the remaining one-count and zero-count region-era cells. Every entry cites a Wikipedia article read in this session (CC BY-SA 4.0, 2026-10-03) and states dating limits in editorialNotes.

title.zh: 米诺斯文明与克里特宫殿社会
title.en: The Minoan civilization and Cretan palace society

summary.zh: 米诺斯文明是青铜时代以克里特岛为中心的文化，常被视为欧洲最早的文明。它由当地新石器文化发展而来，约公元前2000年出现复杂的城市聚落与宫殿建筑。克里特缺少金属矿藏，米诺斯人通过出口农产品与奢侈品换取原料金属，商人与工匠把影响扩展到爱琴海和东地中海。
summary.en: The Minoan civilization was a Bronze Age culture centred on Crete and is often regarded as the first civilisation in Europe. It developed from the local Neolithic culture, with complex urban settlements and palaces appearing around 2000 BCE. Crete lacked metal ores, so Minoans exported agricultural produce and luxury crafts in exchange for raw metals, and their traders and artisans extended influence across the Aegean and eastern Mediterranean.

significance.zh: 米诺斯文明展示了欧洲最早的宫殿经济、远洋贸易与文字使用。
significance.en: Minoan Crete shows Europe's earliest palace economies, maritime trade and script use.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Minoan civilization（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 约前3100年为文化形成期，约前2000年出现宫殿与城市；本条不使用某个宫殿毁于火山或地震的单一年份作为文明终点。
editorialNotes.en: About 3100 BCE marks the formative phase and about 2000 BCE the appearance of palaces and towns; no single destruction year is used as the end of the civilisation.

title.zh: 哈尔施塔特文化：中欧的盐、铁与墓葬
title.en: The Hallstatt culture: salt, iron and burials in Central Europe

summary.zh: 哈尔施塔特文化是公元前12至前6世纪中欧与西欧的主要考古文化，先属青铜时代晚期，后进入早期铁器时代，通常与原始凯尔特语人群相联系。其命名遗址是奥地利萨尔茨卡默古特的湖畔村落哈尔施塔特，当地盐矿带来财富，已发现约1300座墓葬，随葬品显示远距离交换与等级分化。
summary.en: The Hallstatt culture dominated Central and Western Europe from the twelfth to the sixth century BCE, first in the Late Bronze Age and then in the Early Iron Age, and is commonly associated with Proto-Celtic speakers. Its type site is the lakeside village of Hallstatt in Austria's Salzkammergut, where salt mining brought wealth; some 1,300 burials are known, their grave goods showing long-distance exchange and social ranking.

significance.zh: 哈尔施塔特文化把中欧的盐矿财富、铁器技术与跨区域交换联系起来。
significance.en: The Hallstatt culture links Central European salt wealth, iron technology and transregional exchange.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Hallstatt culture（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 该文化跨越青铜时代晚期与早期铁器时代，本条以约前1200—前450年为概括范围，不把某一墓葬或矿层的年代当作整体起点。
editorialNotes.en: The culture spans the Late Bronze Age and Early Iron Age; the c. 1200–450 BCE range is an overview and no single grave or mine layer dates the whole.

title.zh: 二里头文化与中国早期国家
title.en: The Erlitou culture and early state formation in China

summary.zh: 二里头文化是黄河中游的早期青铜时代社会，早期估计为约公元前1900至前1500年，2007年以来的放射性碳研究给出约前1750—前1500年的较窄范围。遗址位于河南偃师，分布遍及河南、山西，后扩展到陕西与湖北；多数考古学者认为它是中国最早的国家级社会，中国学者一般把二里头与夏代后期相联系。
summary.en: The Erlitou culture was an early Bronze Age society in the middle Yellow River valley. Early estimates dated it to about 1900–1500 BCE, while radiocarbon studies since 2007 narrowed it to about 1750–1500 BCE. The type site lies at Yanshi in Henan, with distribution across Henan and Shanxi and later Shaanxi and Hubei; most archaeologists regard it as China's first state-level society, and Chinese scholars generally associate it with the later Xia dynasty.

significance.zh: 二里头是理解中国早期国家、青铜铸造与都邑规划的关键遗址。
significance.en: Erlitou is key to understanding early Chinese statehood, bronze casting and urban planning.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Erlitou culture（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 年代存在约前1900—前1500与约前1750—前1500两种表述，本条并列保留；二里头与夏代的对应仍是学术讨论，不作为已证实的王朝编年。
editorialNotes.en: Two date ranges circulate, c. 1900–1500 and c. 1750–1500 BCE, and both are retained; the identification with the Xia dynasty remains debated and is not presented as a proven dynastic chronology.

title.zh: 埃兰：伊朗西南的古代国家
title.en: Elam: an ancient state in south-western Iran

summary.zh: 埃兰是古代伊朗西部与西南部的文明，范围包括今伊拉姆、胡齐斯坦及伊拉克南部一角，首都苏萨。它参与近东早期的城市化，约公元前3000年起出现文字记录，埃兰语文献延续两千余年。埃兰诸国长期与美索不达米亚政权竞争与结盟，公元前六世纪被波斯阿契美尼德帝国取代。
summary.en: Elam was an ancient civilisation in western and south-western Iran, covering parts of modern Ilam and Khuzestan and a corner of southern Iraq, with its capital at Susa. It took part in the early urbanisation of the Near East, written records appear from about 3000 BCE, and Elamite texts continued for more than two millennia. Elamite states long competed and allied with Mesopotamian powers until the Achaemenid Persians replaced them in the sixth century BCE.

significance.zh: 埃兰把伊朗西南纳入近东早期国家与文字传统，并深刻影响后来的波斯统治。
significance.en: Elam brought south-western Iran into the early state and writing traditions of the Near East and shaped later Persian rule.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Elam（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: “埃兰”是长期存在的多政权与文化集合，本条用约前2700—前539年概括其有文字记录的国家阶段，不表示政治统一。
editorialNotes.en: 'Elam' is a long-lived set of polities and cultures; the c. 2700–539 BCE range summarises its documented state phase and does not imply political unity.

title.zh: cemetery H 文化与印度河晚期的区域转型
title.en: The Cemetery H culture and the late Indus regional transformation

summary.zh: cemetery H 文化是青铜时代印度次大陆北部的区域文化，分布于今旁遮普、哈里亚纳与北方邦西部，约公元前1900年至前1300年。它被视为哈拉帕（印度河）文明晚期的地方形态之一，同时也与印度—雅利安人迁徙的某些阶段相关；名称来自哈拉帕遗址“H区”发现的墓地，葬俗与陶器显示区域变化。
summary.en: The Cemetery H culture was a Bronze Age culture of the northern Indian subcontinent in present-day Punjab, Haryana and western Uttar Pradesh, dated to about 1900–1300 BCE. It is regarded as a regional form of the late Harappan (Indus) civilisation and is also linked to phases of Indo-Aryan migration; the name comes from a cemetery in 'area H' at Harappa, and its burial customs and pottery show regional change.

significance.zh: cemetery H 展示了印度河城市体系衰退后北印度社会的重组过程。
significance.en: Cemetery H shows how northern Indian society reorganised after the Indus urban system declined.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Cemetery H culture（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 该文化的年代约前1900—前1300年；把它与特定族群迁徙直接对应属于解释性观点，本条分开表述考古文化与迁徙假说。
editorialNotes.en: The culture is dated to about 1900–1300 BCE; equating it directly with a specific migration is an interpretive claim, so the archaeological culture and migration hypotheses are kept separate.

title.zh: 帕拉卡斯文化与安第斯纺织传统
title.en: The Paracas culture and Andean textile traditions

summary.zh: 帕拉卡斯文化是约公元前800年至前100年存在于今秘鲁伊卡地区的安第斯社会。居民掌握灌溉与水资源管理，在纺织艺术上成就突出，墓葬出土的精美织物与彩绘陶器显示复杂的社会分工与信仰。关于该社会的大部分信息来自帕拉卡斯半岛海滨遗址的发掘，20世纪20年代由秘鲁考古学家胡利奥·特略首次系统调查。
summary.en: The Paracas culture was an Andean society of the Ica region of Peru between about 800 and 100 BCE. Its people practised irrigation and water management and were especially accomplished in textile arts, and the fine fabrics and painted ceramics from their tombs indicate complex labour organisation and belief. Most knowledge of the society comes from excavations at the seaside Paracas site, first systematically investigated in the 1920s by the Peruvian archaeologist Julio Tello.

significance.zh: 帕拉卡斯文化以纺织与墓葬证据展示了安第斯早期复杂社会。
significance.en: Paracas shows early Andean social complexity through its textiles and funerary evidence.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Paracas culture（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 年代约前800—前100年；帕拉卡斯与后续纳斯卡文化的关系仍有讨论，本条不把两者合并为一个连续政权。
editorialNotes.en: The range is about 800–100 BCE; the relationship with the later Nazca culture remains debated and the two are not merged into one continuous polity.

title.zh: 印度洋贸易网络的长期运行
title.en: The long-run Indian Ocean trading network

summary.zh: 印度洋贸易把东南亚、南亚、中东与东非连接为一个长期的交换体系，商船依靠季风往返，港口城市同时面向海洋与内陆。七至十五世纪，阿拉伯、波斯、印度、马来与斯瓦希里商人运输香料、纺织品、陶瓷、金属与象牙，宗教、语言与技术随航线传播。国家通过港口税与护航获取收入，贸易网络在政治变动中保持韧性。
summary.en: Indian Ocean trade linked Southeast Asia, South Asia, the Middle East and East Africa into a long-lived exchange system in which ships followed the monsoons and port cities faced both sea and hinterland. Between the seventh and fifteenth centuries Arab, Persian, Indian, Malay and Swahili merchants moved spices, textiles, ceramics, metals and ivory, while religions, languages and technologies travelled the same routes. States drew revenue from port duties and protection, and the networks proved resilient to political change.

significance.zh: 印度洋网络说明前现代全球化依赖季风航线与多语港口社会。
significance.en: The Indian Ocean network shows how premodern globalisation depended on monsoon routes and multilingual port societies.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Indian Ocean trade（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 本条描述长期网络，不主张单一航线或统一管理机构；不同商品的流向与规模随时间变化。
editorialNotes.en: This entry describes a long-run network rather than a single route or unified administration; commodity flows and volumes changed over time.

title.zh: 达尔蒂希特与西非早期农牧聚落
title.en: Dhar Tichitt and early farming settlements in West Africa

summary.zh: 达尔蒂希特是毛里塔尼亚西南撒哈拉沙漠中的砂岩崖地带，分布着提希特文化的一系列新石器时代遗址。约公元前2000年至前300年，牧民与农民在此居住，遗址群包括达尔蒂希特、达尔瓦拉塔、达尔内马与达尔塔甘特；达尔蒂希特可能是该传统中等级化社会结构的区域中心，也是西非已知最早的定居遗址之一。
summary.en: Dhar Tichitt is a line of sandstone cliffs in the south-western Sahara in Mauritania with a series of Neolithic sites of the Tichitt tradition. Pastoralists and farmers lived there between about 2000 and 300 BCE across the Dhar Tichitt, Dhar Walata, Dhar Néma and Dhar Tagant groups; Dhar Tichitt may have been the regional centre of a hierarchical social structure and is among the oldest known occupation sites in West Africa.

significance.zh: 达尔蒂希特记录了撒哈拉湿润期西非农牧社会与聚落组织的早期形态。
significance.en: Dhar Tichitt records early farming and herding society and settlement organisation in West Africa during the Saharan humid phase.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Dhar Tichitt（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 年代约为公元前2000—前300年；遗址群是否构成单一政体仍待研究，本条按聚落传统表述。
editorialNotes.en: The range is about 2000–300 BCE; whether the sites formed a single polity remains unresolved, so the entry describes a settlement tradition.

title.zh: 达马特：埃塞俄比亚高原的早期王国
title.en: Dʿmt: an early kingdom in the Ethiopian highlands

summary.zh: 达马特是位于今厄立特里亚与埃塞俄比亚北部提格雷地区的埃塞俄比亚—萨巴王国。其确切年代不明，学界提出约公元前8世纪末至前6世纪的时段假设。由于留存铭文很少、考古工作有限，达马特是否在阿克苏姆早期之前结束、是否演变为阿克苏姆国家，或只是后被阿克苏姆统一的地方政权之一，仍无定论。
summary.en: Dʿmt was an Ethio-Sabean kingdom in present-day Eritrea and the northern Tigray region of Ethiopia. Its exact dates are unknown, with a hypothesised span from the late eighth to the sixth century BCE. Because few inscriptions survive and archaeological work is limited, it remains unclear whether Dʿmt ended before the early Aksumite state, evolved into it, or was one of the smaller states later united by Aksum.

significance.zh: 达马特是理解埃塞俄比亚高原早期国家与阿克苏姆起源的关键但证据有限的环节。
significance.en: Dʿmt is a crucial but poorly evidenced link in understanding early statehood in the Ethiopian highlands and the origins of Aksum.

sources.title: Wikipedia — D'mt（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 年代仅为假设（约前8世纪末—前6世纪），证据有限；本条明确保留不确定性，不把达马特写成阿克苏姆的直接前身。
editorialNotes.en: The dating is hypothetical (late eighth to sixth century BCE) and evidence is limited; the entry keeps the uncertainty explicit and does not present Dʿmt as the direct predecessor of Aksum.

title.zh: 《经国大典》最终颁行
title.en: Final promulgation of the Gyeongguk daejeon

summary.zh: 1485年，朝鲜王朝在多次修订后颁行《经国大典》的最终版本（乙巳大典）。这部法典汇集高丽末年至朝鲜初年的法律、惯例与诏令，按六曹分类编排，成为此后五百余年朝鲜政治与行政的基础；现存版本为1613年重印本。
summary.en: In 1485 the Joseon court released the final version of the Gyeongguk daejeon, the Ulsa code, after several revisions. The code gathered laws, customs and decrees from the late Goryeo and early Joseon periods, arranged by the six ministries, and became the basis of Joseon government for over five centuries; the surviving edition is a 1613 reprint.

significance.zh: 《经国大典》把朝鲜的国家制度固定为可援引的法典，影响延续至19世纪。
significance.en: The Gyeongguk daejeon fixed Joseon's institutions in a citable code whose influence lasted into the nineteenth century.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Gyeongguk daejeon（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 1485年为第三版（乙巳大典）颁行年，此前有1471年辛卯大典与1474年甲午大典等版本。
editorialNotes.en: 1485 is the year the third version, the Ulsa code, was released; earlier versions included those of 1471 and 1474.

title.zh: 中国加入世界贸易组织
title.en: China joins the World Trade Organization

summary.zh: 2001年12月11日，中国在长时间谈判与国内经济调整后正式加入世界贸易组织。此后中国制造业出口迅速扩大，全球供应链与贸易格局发生显著变化，相关影响后来被称为“中国冲击”；围绕世贸规则与中国经济模式适配性的争论延续至今。
summary.en: On 11 December 2001 China formally joined the World Trade Organization after lengthy negotiations and significant changes to its economy. Manufacturing exports expanded rapidly afterwards and global supply chains and trade patterns shifted markedly, an effect later called the China shock, while debate over the fit between WTO rules and China's economic model continues.

significance.zh: 入世使中国深度嵌入全球贸易体系，也重塑了21世纪初的世界经济格局。
significance.en: WTO accession embedded China deeply in global trade and reshaped the world economy in the early twenty-first century.

sources.title: Wikipedia — China and the World Trade Organization（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 本条只陈述加入年份与谈判背景；对就业、产业与贸易失衡的具体影响学界仍在争论。
editorialNotes.en: The entry states the accession year and negotiation background only; the precise effects on employment, industry and trade imbalances remain debated.

title.zh: 卡尔吉王朝与德里苏丹国的扩张
title.en: The Khalji dynasty and the expansion of the Delhi Sultanate

summary.zh: 1290年，贾拉尔丁·卡尔吉建立卡尔吉王朝，成为德里苏丹国的第二个统治家族，至1320年共约三十年。阿拉乌丁·卡尔吉时期苏丹国疆域达到最大，他推行军事、行政与价格管制改革，并多次击退蒙古入侵，为德里在14世纪的政治主导地位奠定基础。
summary.en: In 1290 Jalal-ud-Din Khalji founded the Khalji dynasty, the second ruling house of the Delhi Sultanate, which lasted about three decades until 1320. Under Alauddin Khalji the sultanate reached its greatest territorial extent, with military, administrative and price-control reforms and repeated repulsion of Mongol invasions, laying the basis for Delhi's fourteenth-century dominance.

significance.zh: 卡尔吉时期把德里苏丹国推向南印度，并建立了影响后世的行政与市场管理制度。
significance.en: The Khalji period pushed the Delhi Sultanate into southern India and created administrative and market regulations that influenced later rule.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Khalji dynasty（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 王朝起止为1290—1320年；阿拉乌丁的远征与价格管制措施的规模在研究中仍有不同评价。
editorialNotes.en: The dynasty is dated 1290–1320; the scale and effects of Alauddin's campaigns and price controls are still assessed differently in the literature.

title.zh: 斋浦尔建城与18世纪拉杰普特政治
title.en: The founding of Jaipur and eighteenth-century Rajput politics

summary.zh: 安梅尔土邦王公萨瓦伊·贾伊·辛格二世于1727年规划并营建新都斋浦尔，以网格街道、市场与水利设施组成有规划的城市，1743年他去世前城市格局基本成形。他早年名义上仍是莫卧儿帝国的封臣，同时在天文观测与建筑上留下重要成果。
summary.en: Sawai Jai Singh II of Amber planned and built the new capital of Jaipur from 1727, laying out a grid of streets, markets and waterworks; the city's form was largely established before his death in 1743. Nominally still a Mughal vassal in his early years, he also left major achievements in astronomy and architecture.

significance.zh: 斋浦尔是南亚少见的按规划新建的18世纪都城，反映莫卧儿秩序瓦解后地方政权的组织能力。
significance.en: Jaipur is a rare planned eighteenth-century South Asian capital and shows the organisational capacity of regional powers as Mughal order fragmented.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Jai Singh II（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 1727年为建城之年，1743年为王公去世之年；本条用1727—1743表示城市规划与营建期，不表示城市在此期间才有人居住。
editorialNotes.en: 1727 is the year the city was founded and 1743 the year the ruler died; the range marks the planning and building phase and does not imply the site was previously uninhabited.

title.zh: 白羊王朝与乌尊·哈桑的鼎盛
title.en: The Aq Qoyunlu and the zenith under Uzun Hasan

summary.zh: 白羊王朝是土库曼部落联盟，1378年起以迪亚巴克尔为基地发展，15世纪中叶取代黑羊王朝控制伊朗西部与伊拉克。乌尊·哈桑（1453—1478年在位）时期达到鼎盛，统治范围包括亚美尼亚、阿塞拜疆与伊朗大部，并与奥斯曼帝国和威尼斯等地展开外交与战争。
summary.en: The Aq Qoyunlu were a Turkoman tribal confederation that grew from a Diyarbakir base after 1378 and in the mid-fifteenth century replaced the Qara Qoyunlu in western Iran and Iraq. Under Uzun Hasan (ruled 1453–1478) the confederation peaked, ruling Armenia, Azerbaijan and much of Iran while conducting diplomacy and war with the Ottomans, Venice and others.

significance.zh: 白羊王朝是萨法维王朝兴起前伊朗与安纳托利亚之间的主要政治力量。
significance.en: The Aq Qoyunlu were the leading power between Iran and Anatolia before the rise of the Safavids.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Aq Qoyunlu（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 王朝整体年代为1378—1508年，本条聚焦乌尊·哈桑在位期（1453—1478）的鼎盛阶段。
editorialNotes.en: The confederation spans 1378–1508; this entry focuses on the peak during Uzun Hasan's reign from 1453 to 1478.

title.zh: 杜兰尼帝国的建立
title.en: Foundation of the Durrani Empire

summary.zh: 1747年，艾哈迈德沙·杜兰尼在坎大哈建立杜兰尼帝国，被认为是现代阿富汗国家的起点。帝国鼎盛时统治今阿富汗、巴基斯坦大部与伊朗东北部、印度西北部部分地区，与奥斯曼帝国并列为18世纪后期重要的伊斯兰帝国；1772年艾哈迈德沙去世后扩张放缓。
summary.en: In 1747 Ahmad Shah Durrani founded the Durrani Empire at Kandahar, widely regarded as the starting point of the modern Afghan state. At its height it ruled present-day Afghanistan, much of Pakistan and parts of north-eastern Iran and north-western India, ranking with the Ottoman Empire among the major Islamic empires of the later eighteenth century; expansion slowed after his death in 1772.

significance.zh: 杜兰尼帝国把阿富汗高原的部落力量整合为区域性帝国，其政治遗产影响至今。
significance.en: The Durrani Empire united Afghan tribal forces into a regional empire whose political legacy persists.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Durrani Empire（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 1747年为建国年，1772年为艾哈迈德沙去世年；帝国此后延续至19世纪初，本条只覆盖其扩张期。
editorialNotes.en: 1747 is the founding year and 1772 the year Ahmad Shah died; the empire continued into the early nineteenth century, and this entry covers its expansion phase only.

title.zh: 第一次英阿战争
title.en: The First Anglo-Afghan War

summary.zh: 第一次英阿战争（1838—1842）是英国与锡克帝国支持杜兰尼系的舒贾沙阿、对抗喀布尔与坎大哈的巴拉克扎伊王朝的战争，也是“大博弈”初期的重要冲突。英军1839年占领喀布尔并扶植舒贾沙阿，但1841至1842年遭到全面反抗，撤退中损失惨重，最终放弃长期占领。
summary.en: The First Anglo-Afghan War (1838–1842) was fought by Britain and the Sikh Empire in support of the Durrani claimant Shuja Shah against the Barakzai rulers of Kabul and Kandahar, an early major conflict of the Great Game. British forces occupied Kabul in 1839 and restored Shuja Shah, but a general uprising in 1841–42 led to a disastrous retreat and the abandonment of lasting occupation.

significance.zh: 这场战争暴露了外来军队在阿富汗维持占领的困难，成为19世纪帝国竞争的典型案例。
significance.en: The war exposed the difficulty foreign armies faced in holding Afghanistan and became a classic case of nineteenth-century imperial rivalry.

sources.title: Wikipedia — First Anglo-Afghan War（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 战争起止为1838—1842年；伤亡与撤退细节在不同史料中的数字差异很大，本条不作具体人数陈述。
editorialNotes.en: The war is dated 1838–1842; casualty and retreat figures vary widely between sources, so no specific numbers are given.

title.zh: 大博弈与中亚边界的划定
title.en: The Great Game and the making of Central Asian borders

summary.zh: 19世纪，英国与俄罗斯帝国围绕中亚、阿富汗、波斯与西藏的影响力展开长期竞争，史称“大博弈”。俄罗斯征服突厥斯坦，英国扩张并划定英属印度边界，双方通过军事干预与外交谈判重新界定领土；到20世纪初，两国之间形成一条由独立或半独立政权、部落与君主国构成的缓冲带。
summary.en: In the nineteenth century Britain and the Russian Empire competed for influence across Central Asia, Afghanistan, Persia and Tibet in what became known as the Great Game. Russia conquered Turkestan while Britain expanded and defined the borders of British India, and military intervention and diplomacy redrew territory, leaving by the early twentieth century a buffer of independent or semi-independent states, tribes and monarchies.

significance.zh: 大博弈塑造了中亚与南亚的现代边界，其影响延续到当代地缘政治。
significance.en: The Great Game shaped modern Central and South Asian borders with effects that persist in contemporary geopolitics.

sources.title: Wikipedia — The Great Game（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: “大博弈”是后世概括的术语，时间范围并无统一界定；本条用约1830—1895年表示竞争最激烈的阶段。
editorialNotes.en: The term is a later label without a single agreed span; the c. 1830–1895 range marks the most intense phase of rivalry.

title.en: The war in Afghanistan, 2001–2021

summary.zh: 2001年，美国领导的联军以“持久自由行动”名义入侵阿富汗，回应九一一袭击，塔利班政权被推翻。2004年建立美国支持的伊斯兰共和国，但塔利班重新组织并长期作战；2021年外国军队撤离后塔利班重新掌权，持续二十年的战争结束。
summary.en: In 2001 a United States-led coalition invaded Afghanistan under Operation Enduring Freedom in response to the September 11 attacks, toppling the Taliban government. A US-backed Islamic Republic was established in 2004, but the Taliban reorganised and fought on; after foreign forces withdrew in 2021 the Taliban returned to power, ending twenty years of war.

significance.zh: 这场战争改变了21世纪国际安全与干预政策的讨论框架。
significance.en: The war reshaped twenty-first-century debates on international security and intervention.

sources.title: Wikipedia — War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 本条只陈述战争起止与主要政治节点；平民伤亡与各方责任的统计差异很大，未引用具体数字。
editorialNotes.en: The entry states the war's span and main political milestones; casualty figures and assessments of responsibility vary widely and no numbers are cited.

title.zh: 北海帝国与维京时代晚期的跨海王权
title.en: The North Sea Empire and late Viking-Age thalassocracy

summary.zh: 北海帝国是1013年至1042年间英格兰、丹麦与挪威三国的共主联合，由丹麦国王斯韦恩·八字胡开始统一，其子克努特大帝完成并维持。这个“海上帝国”依靠海路联系各王国，是维京时代晚期跨海王权的典型；1042年克努特家族绝嗣后联合解体。
summary.en: The North Sea Empire was a personal union of England, Denmark and Norway that lasted for most of 1013–1042, begun by Sweyn Forkbeard of Denmark and completed and maintained by his son Cnut the Great. This sea-connected empire exemplifies late Viking-Age rule across waters; the union dissolved when Cnut's line ended in 1042.

significance.zh: 北海帝国显示海路而非陆地疆界可以支撑跨王国统治，也加速了英格兰与北欧的政治联系。
significance.en: The North Sea Empire shows how sea routes rather than land frontiers could sustain rule over several kingdoms and deepened ties between England and Scandinavia.

sources.title: Wikipedia — North Sea Empire（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 联合的起止通常记为1013—1042年，中间1014—1016年一度分裂；本条用整体时段表述。
editorialNotes.en: The union is usually dated 1013–1042, with a brief division in 1014–1016; the entry uses the overall span.

title.zh: 西西里王国的建立
title.en: Foundation of the Kingdom of Sicily

summary.zh: 1130年，罗杰二世建立西西里王国，统治西西里岛与意大利南部，其前身是1071年诺曼人征服后形成的西西里伯国。王国一度扩展至北非，拉丁、希腊与阿拉伯文化在宫廷与行政中并存；1194年诺曼王朝被霍亨斯陶芬家族取代。
summary.en: In 1130 Roger II founded the Kingdom of Sicily, ruling the island and southern Italy from the Norman county established after the conquest of 1071. The kingdom briefly extended into North Africa and its court and administration combined Latin, Greek and Arab traditions, until the Hohenstaufen replaced the Norman dynasty in 1194.

significance.zh: 西西里王国是地中海多元文化王权的代表，连接拉丁欧洲、拜占庭与伊斯兰世界。
significance.en: The Kingdom of Sicily exemplifies a multicultural Mediterranean monarchy linking Latin Europe, Byzantium and the Islamic world.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Kingdom of Sicily（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 王国名义上延续到1816年，本条聚焦1130—1194年的诺曼时期。
editorialNotes.en: The kingdom nominally lasted until 1816; this entry focuses on the Norman period of 1130–1194.

title.zh: 第三次十字军
title.en: The Third Crusade

summary.zh: 第三次十字军（1189—1192）由英格兰的理查一世、法国的腓力二世与神圣罗马帝国皇帝腓特烈一世发起，回应萨拉丁1187年夺取耶路撒冷。十字军收复阿卡与雅法并逆转萨拉丁的大部分征服，但未能夺回耶路撒冷，最终以允许朝圣者通行的停战协议结束。
summary.en: The Third Crusade (1189–1192) was launched by Richard I of England, Philip II of France and Emperor Frederick Barbarossa in response to Saladin's capture of Jerusalem in 1187. It recovered Acre and Jaffa and reversed most of Saladin's conquests but failed to retake Jerusalem, ending with a truce that allowed pilgrims access.

significance.zh: 第三次十字军确立了12世纪末东地中海的力量均衡，也留下跨宗教谈判与通行的先例。
significance.en: The Third Crusade established the late twelfth-century balance in the eastern Mediterranean and left precedents for negotiation and access across religious lines.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Third Crusade（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 时间为1189—1192年；腓特烈一世在途中去世，实际指挥以理查与腓力为主。
editorialNotes.en: The crusade is dated 1189–1192; Frederick Barbarossa died en route, leaving Richard and Philip as the effective leaders.

title.zh: 西班牙王位继承战争
title.en: The War of the Spanish Succession

summary.zh: 西班牙王位继承战争（1701—1714）因1700年卡洛斯二世去世无嗣而爆发，法国支持的安茹公爵腓力与奥地利哈布斯堡支持的查理大公争夺王位，英国、荷兰等组成大同盟对抗法国。战争以《乌得勒支和约》等结束，波旁家族获得西班牙王位，欧洲均势与海外殖民地格局随之调整。
summary.en: The War of the Spanish Succession (1701–1714) broke out after Charles II of Spain died childless in 1700, with Philip of Anjou backed by France and Archduke Charles by the Austrian Habsburgs while Britain, the Dutch and others formed a Grand Alliance against France. It ended with the treaties of Utrecht and related agreements: the Bourbons kept the Spanish throne and the European balance and overseas empires were rearranged.

significance.zh: 这场战争确立了18世纪欧洲的均势格局，并把海外贸易与殖民地权利纳入和约安排。
significance.en: The war fixed the eighteenth-century European balance and brought overseas trade and colonial rights into treaty settlements.

sources.title: Wikipedia — War of the Spanish Succession（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 相关冲突还包括北方战争与北美安妮女王战争，本条只叙述西班牙王位继承主线。
editorialNotes.en: Related conflicts included the Great Northern War and Queen Anne's War; this entry covers the Spanish succession main line only.

title.zh: 米塔劳役制与安第斯殖民经济
title.en: The mit'a labour system and the Andean colonial economy

summary.zh: 米塔是安第斯地区强制轮换劳役制度，印加国家以劳役形式征税，用于修筑道路、桥梁、梯田与要塞。西班牙殖民当局沿用并改造这一制度，把安第斯村落劳动力征调到银矿与种植园；波托西银矿1545年开发后，米塔成为殖民经济与地方社会压迫的核心机制之一。
summary.en: Mit'a was a system of rotating mandatory labour in the Andes: the Inca state collected tribute in labour for roads, bridges, terraces and fortresses. Spanish authorities adapted it to channel Andean village labour to silver mines and estates, and after the Potosi mines opened in 1545 the mit'a became a central mechanism of the colonial economy and of local coercion.

significance.zh: 米塔显示殖民政权如何改造既有制度以提取劳动力与白银。
significance.en: The mit'a shows how a colonial regime adapted an existing institution to extract labour and silver.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Mit'a（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 本条以波托西银矿开发（1545）至16世纪末概括殖民米塔制的运行期；来源描述其制度性质，未给出单一设立年份。
editorialNotes.en: The entry uses the opening of Potosi in 1545 to the end of the sixteenth century to frame the colonial mit'a; the source describes the institution without giving a single founding year.

title.zh: 新法兰西与北美内陆贸易网络
title.en: New France and the North American interior trade network

summary.zh: 新法兰西是法国在北美大陆的殖民地体系，始于1534年卡蒂埃对圣劳伦斯湾的探索，1763年《巴黎条约》割让给英国与西班牙后结束。其鼎盛期1712年包含加拿大、哈得孙湾、阿卡迪亚、纽芬兰与路易斯安那五个殖民地，毛皮贸易与河流—湖泊航道把内陆各族群与魁北克、蒙特利尔等据点连接起来。
summary.en: New France was France's colonial system in mainland North America, beginning with Jacques Cartier's exploration of the Gulf of Saint Lawrence in 1534 and ending with the cession to Britain and Spain in the Treaty of Paris of 1763. At its peak in 1712 it comprised five colonies—Canada, Hudson Bay, Acadia, Newfoundland and Louisiana—and the fur trade along rivers and lakes linked interior nations with posts such as Quebec and Montreal.

significance.zh: 新法兰西以毛皮贸易与联盟而非密集移民立国，塑造了北美内陆的长期格局。
significance.en: New France rested on the fur trade and alliances rather than dense settlement, shaping the North American interior for generations.

sources.title: Wikipedia — New France（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 1534年为首次探索之年，1763年为割让之年；加拿大殖民地内部又以魁北克、三河城与蒙特利尔分区。
editorialNotes.en: 1534 marks the first exploration and 1763 the cession; the Canada colony was itself divided into the districts of Quebec, Trois-Rivières and Montreal.

title.zh: 加勒比甘蔗种植园经济的扩张
title.en: The expansion of the Caribbean sugar plantation economy

summary.zh: 18至20世纪，甘蔗种植与制糖成为加勒比岛屿经济的主体，岛上大片土地用于蔗田与糖厂。种植园的主要劳动力在奴隶制废除前是被奴役的非洲人，此后则来自印度、中国、葡萄牙等地的契约劳工。加勒比糖业一度供应世界市场的大部分食糖，其利润与奴隶制、殖民贸易紧密相连。
summary.en: In the eighteenth to twentieth centuries sugar cane and refining dominated Caribbean island economies, with much land given to cane fields and mills. The main labour force was enslaved Africans until the abolition of slavery, after which indentured labourers came from India, China, Portugal and elsewhere. Caribbean sugar supplied most of the world market at times, its profits bound up with slavery and colonial trade.

significance.zh: 加勒比糖业把种植园、奴隶制与全球消费市场连接为一体，是近代世界经济的核心案例。
significance.en: Caribbean sugar linked plantations, slavery and global consumer markets, a central case in the making of the modern world economy.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Sugar plantations in the Caribbean（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 本条用1700—1900年概括种植园经济的全盛与转型期；不同岛屿的兴衰年代差异较大。
editorialNotes.en: The 1700–1900 range covers the plantation economy's peak and transformation; individual islands rose and declined at different times.

title.zh: 太平洋岛国论坛与区域合作
title.en: The Pacific Islands Forum and regional cooperation

summary.zh: 太平洋岛国论坛于1971年以“南太平洋论坛”名义成立，旨在促进大洋洲国家与地区在贸易、渔业、气候变化与安全等领域的合作。随着成员国独立与区域组织扩展，论坛成为太平洋岛屿在国际气候谈判与海洋治理中的共同发声平台，并开展区域维和与渔业管理合作。
summary.en: The Pacific Islands Forum was founded in 1971 as the South Pacific Forum to promote cooperation among Pacific countries and territories on trade, fisheries, climate change and security. As members became independent and regional bodies expanded, it became a common platform for Pacific islands in international climate negotiations and ocean governance, with regional peacekeeping and fisheries management.

significance.zh: 论坛体现了小岛国通过区域组织在国际事务中集体发声的能力。
significance.en: The forum shows how small island states can speak collectively in international affairs through regional organisation.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Pacific Islands Forum（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 1971年为成立年；1999年由“南太平洋论坛”更名为“太平洋岛国论坛”。
editorialNotes.en: 1971 is the founding year; the body was renamed from the South Pacific Forum to the Pacific Islands Forum in 1999.
